why: NAV's registered unemployment, not SSB's AKU rate. Out of scope until NAV is added (D16); checking it against AKU (about 4.6 %) would be a false alarm. Before D16's AKU step this case was plain 'Arbeidsledigheten', which is now checked against AKU.
